## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at 1-4 Marble Arch.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> See the **Moco Masters** collection at Moco Museum. This collection features work from world-renowned artists including Andy Warhol, Jean-Michel Basquiat, Yayoi Kusama, Keith Haring, Damien Hirst, Jeff Koons, Tom Wesselman, and Pablo Picasso.
>
> On the first floor, view works by **Moco Contemporary Masters**. This includes pieces by Tracey Emin, KAWS, Banksy, Chris Levine, Julian Opie, JR, Takashi Murakami, and Hayden Kays. British music icon Robbie Williams also showcases his collection _Pride and Self-Prejudice,_ focusing on his mental health journey. These works have never been displayed in the UK before.
